verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no user-definable rules engine in Vanta that binds a trigger condition to an automatic action. Webhooks (vanta-docs-4) only push event notifications, so the user must build the action handler; that makes them a developer building block. Custom Tests produce pass/fail evidence rather than triggering actions, and the automated reminders, workflows and Trust Center approvals are fixed built-in features, not rules the user defines.
